Done. This was a single-owner, two-file change, so I executed it directly rather than splitting it into parallel workstreams (delegation overhead would exceed the work, and both files are needed together to verify).

## Root cause
`c.redirect` only ran `encodeURI` when the location contained non-Latin-1 characters. ASCII-only locations — the common case — passed raw `\r` / `\n` straight into `Headers.set('Location', …)`. In Node/undici that throws (`Headers.set: "ab" is an invalid header value`), and on runtimes that tolerate it, it is a response-splitting vector.

## Fix — `src/context.ts:772-783`
```ts
const locationString = String(location)
// Multibytes should be encoded
// eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex
const encodedLocation = !/[^\x00-\xFF]/.test(locationString)
  ? locationString
  : encodeURI(locationString)
this.header(
  'Location',
  // CR and LF must never be emitted verbatim in a header value (header injection /
  // response splitting). Encode them even when the rest of the URL is plain ASCII.
  encodedLocation.replace(/[\r\n]/g, encodeURIComponent)
)
```
- Raw CR/LF → `%0D` / `%0A` on **both** the ASCII and multibyte paths.
- No behavior change for valid redirects: ASCII URLs (including pre-encoded `%XX` sequences, `://`, query strings) remain byte-identical; multibyte handling is unchanged; status code and response shape untouched.
- Percent-encoded input is not double-encoded (`%` is never re-escaped).

## Tests — `src/context.test.ts:132-171`
`describe('c.redirect() header injection')` covers:
- raw `\r\n` + injected header name → `Location` is `/destination%0D%0AX-Injected: 1`, and `X-Injected` is absent (no real header injected) — `:133`
- lone `\r` and lone `\n` — `:141`
- status preservation (301) with encoded trailing CRLF — `:146`
- CRLF combined with multibyte chars — `:152`
- percent-encoded inputs (`%0D%0A`, `%0d%0a`, `%0A`) unchanged, no double-encoding — `:163`

## Verification
- `pnpm exec vp test --run src/context.test.ts` → **70 passed (1 file)**.
- Regression proof: with the old `context.ts` restored, the new tests fail (3 failed / 67 passed); with the fix, all pass.
- Related suites: `src/hono.test.ts` + `src/middleware/trailing-slash/index.test.ts` → 261 passed.
- `pnpm run lint` → exit 0, no findings in changed files; `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` clean; `vp fmt --check` clean (formatting normalized via `vp fmt`).
